desc: A translucent green mound of acid taller than most humans.
motives: Camouflage, creep up, envelop, multiply

features.name: Lento
features.text: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Forma Acida
features.text: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Avviluppare
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze Envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While Enveloped, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all Enveloped targets are freed and the condition is cleared.

features.name: Scissione
features.text: When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

name: Idra
desc: A quadrupedal scaled beast with multiple long-necked heads, each filled with menacing fangs.
motives: Devour, regenerate, terrify

features.name: Minaccia dalle Molte Teste
features.text: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.

features.name: Inesorabile (X)
features.text: The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra’s number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Rigenerazione
features.text: If the Hydra has any marked HP, spend a Fear to clear a HP and grow two heads.

features.name: Coro Terrificante
features.text: All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.

features.name: Debolezza Magica
features.text: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become Dazed until the next roll with Fear. While Dazed, they can’t use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

name: Lamia
desc: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.
motives: Attack the unaware, avoid sunlight, leech life force, put to sleep, slither through tall grass

features.name: Costrizione
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

features.name: Succhia Vita
features.text: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4−1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Tossina Soporifera
features.text: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

name: Lampara Ingannatrice
desc: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.
motives: Entice with secret knowledge, snap the trap shut, speak through a shapeshifted head stalk

features.name: Esca Mutaforme
features.text: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler’s head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. Mark a Stress to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler’s head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

features.name: Adescare
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler’s head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

features.name: Deglutire
features.text: When a PC moves within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes 3d6 physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and takes 3d6 physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

name: Manticora
desc: A legendary beast that has a human’s face, lion’s body, scorpion’s tail, and dragon’s wings.
motives: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Indovina un po’
features.text: The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.

features.name: Alata
features.text: While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Attacco Balzante
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20+6 physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

features.name: Spina Caudale Paralizzante
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d8 physical damage and becomes Restrained until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Serrare le Mascelle
features.text: When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target Restrained and Vulnerable until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

name: Monarca
desc: The sovereign ruler of a nation, wreathed in the privilege of tradition and wielding unmatched power in their domain.
motives: Control vassals, destroy rivals, forge a legacy

features.name: A Morte!
features.text: Spend a Fear per PC in the party to have the group condemned for crimes real or imagined. A PC who succeeds on a Presence Roll can demand trial by combat or another special form of trial.

features.name: Guardie della Corona
features.text: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon six Tier 3 Minions, who appear at Close range to enforce the Monarch’s will.

features.name: Casus Belli
features.text: Long-Term Countdown (8). Spend a Fear to activate after the Monarch’s desire for war is first revealed. When it triggers, the Monarch has a reason to rally the nation to war and the support to act on that reason. You gain 1d4 Fear.

name: Prole della Notte
desc: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.
motives: Carry victims back to master, overrun settlements, slither through shadow

features.name: Orda (2d6+2)
features.text: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+2 physical damage instead.

features.name: Ingrossare le Fila
features.text: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde’s ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Sopraffare
features.text: When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

name: Sacerdote del Dolore
desc: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suffering and ecstasy.
motives: Feed on emotions, locate the innocent or curious, tempt them with their deepest desires

features.name: Camminare Tra i Mondi
features.text: Mark a Stress to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

features.name: Dolore e Piacere
features.text: When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

name: Fenice
desc: A huge eagle that’s made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.
motives: Flee pursuers, live brilliantly, soar through the heavens, wield light and flame

features.name: Aura Purificatrice
features.text: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix’s Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.

features.name: Seme di Fuoco
features.text: The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range. Resurrection - Evolution: When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals 3d4 direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

name: Plesiosauro
desc: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.
motives: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully

features.name: Solo un Mito
features.text: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can’t be located or targeted.

features.name: Muro d’Acqua
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take 3d10 physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

name: Roc
desc: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.
motives: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Rapace
features.text: Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

features.name: Arriva il Tuono
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take 3d12 magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Stretta Stritolatrice
features.text: When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). Nest Warden - Evolution: When the Roc’s eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:

features.name: Gonfio di Rabbia
features.text: The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.

features.name: Aura Elettrificata
features.text: The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

name: Wyrm delle Sabbie
desc: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.
motives: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends

features.name: Pungiglione Velenoso
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes 3d10+2 physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Restrained and Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Divorare
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.

features.name: Affamato, Non Stupido
features.text: When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

name: Demone Mutaforme
desc: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.
motives: Impersonate, sow discord, tempt betrayal

features.name: Natura Demoniaca
features.text: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can’t be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Impersonare
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they’re in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must mark a Stress.

features.name: Divenire invisibile
features.text: Mark a Stress to make the Fiend Hidden until they make an action roll or take damage.

features.name: Consiglio Ambiguo
features.text: When a PC makes an action roll while the Fiend is in the scene, you can mark a Stress to add 1d6 to the result of their Fear Die.

features.name: Smascherato! (Cambio di Fase)
features.text: When the Fiend is defeated or the PCs discover its true identity, replace the Fiend with Shapeshifting Fiend Revealed and immediately spotlight them.

name: Demone Mutaforme Smascherato
desc: A towering humanoid who has an insectile head and multiple sets of glowing red eyes.
motives: Claim souls, confuse and misdirect, escape to the Circles Below, teleport

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Fiend can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Resistenza Demoniaca
features.text: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can’t be fooled by magic illusions.

features.name: Furia Demoniaca
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with a bonus to the attack roll equal the amount of Stress the Fiend has marked. On a success, the attack deals direct damage.

features.name: Sala degli Specchi
features.text: Mark 2 Stress to have the Fiend summon four illusory duplicates and activate a Duplicate Countdown (4). When the Fiend is targeted by an attack, they gain a bonus to their Difficulty equal to the countdown die’s current value. The countdown ticks down when a PC fails an attack against the Fiend. When it triggers, the duplicates vanish.

features.name: Artigliata Fulminea
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Fiend unleash an arc of magical energy. Make an attack roll against all targets within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 3d20 magic damage.

features.name: Giochetti Mentali
features.text: When an attack targeting the Fiend from beyond Very Close range succeeds with Fear, you can mark a Stress to have the Fiend instantly switch places with a PC within Very Close range. The PC takes the damage instead.

name: Cavaliere del Cervo
desc: A knight with huge, majestic antlers wearing armor made of dangerous thorns.
motives: Isolate, maneuver, protect the forest, weed the unwelcome

features.name: Dall’Alto
features.text: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 3d12+3 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Spada della Foresta
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to 3d4 + the target’s Major threshold.

features.name: Corazza di Spine
features.text: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d10+5 physical damage to the attacker.

name: Titano delle Tempeste
desc: An ancient, wise, and temperamental goliath who has hair made of mist and electricity crackling across their skin.
motives: Erupt violently, wait, watch

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Slancio
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Fulmine Globulare
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Titan conjure 1d4 spheres of electrical energy within Close range. When the Titan is spotlighted, they can move each sphere up to Close range. When a sphere moves within Very Close range of a PC, the PC takes 4d6 magic damage, and the sphere disappears. Each sphere has the same Difficulty as the Titan and disappears if a creature deals magic damage to it.

features.name: Portatore di Tempesta
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Titan conjure a raging storm. Each PC within Close range of the Titan must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Rombo di Tuono
features.text: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Titan within Close range. Each target marks a Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

name: Treant delle Querce
desc: A sturdy animate old-growth tree.
motives: Hide in plain sight, preserve the forest, root down, swing branches

features.name: Solo un Albero
features.text: Before they make their first attack in a fight or after they become Hidden, the Treant is indistinguishable from other trees until they next act or a PC succeeds on an Instinct Roll to identify them.

features.name: Sventagliata di Ghiande
features.text: Mark a Stress and make an attack against up to three targets within Close range, pummeling them with giant acorns. Targets the Treant succeeds against take 2d10+5 physical damage.

features.name: Mettere Radici
features.text: Mark a Stress to Root the Treant in place. The Treant is Restrained while Rooted, and can end this effect instead of moving while they are spotlighted. While Rooted, the Treant has resistance to physical damage.

name: Treant Arbusto
desc: A small, sentient tree sapling.
motives: Blend in, preserve the forest, pummel, surround

features.name: Seguace (6)
features.text: The Sapling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sapling, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Attacco in Massa
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Treant Saplings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 8 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Unicorno
desc: A celestial avatar of goodness in the form of a preternaturally beautiful horse with a long, spiraled horn emerging from its head.
motives: Keep evil at bay, protect the sacred, sense emotions and intent

features.name: Lancia Celestiale
features.text: The Unicorn’s standard attack deals double damage to a creature that has dealt damage to it.

features.name: Tocco Curativo
features.text: The Unicorn touches its horn to an ally within Melee range and channels healing energy into them. Mark any number of Stress to clear an equal number of the ally’s HP.

features.name: Aura Protettrice
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn conjure a sparkling magical aura. While the aura is in effect, attack rolls made against the Unicorn or an ally within Very Close range are made with disadvantage. This effect lasts until the Unicorn takes damage.

features.name: Teletrasporto
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Unicorn teleport up to Very Far range. The Unicorn can bring up to three allies within Very Close range with it.

name: Vampiro Dominante
desc: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.
motives: Create thralls, charm, command, fly, intimidate

features.name: Terrificante
features.text: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Guardami!
features.text: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain 1d4 Fear.

features.name: Nutrirsi dei Seguaci
features.text: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: La Caccia È Aperta
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Prosciugare la Vita
features.text: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a d8. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.

name: Vampiro
desc: An intelligent undead with blood-stained lips and a predator’s smile.
motives: Bite, charm, deceive, feed, intimidate

features.name: Morso Succhiasangue
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 5d4 physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack loses a Hope and must mark a Stress. The Vampire then clears a HP.

features.name: Forma di Nebbia
features.text: When the Vampire takes physical damage, you can spend a Fear to take half damage.

name: Sciame di Pipistrelli Vampiro
desc: A cloud of blood-sucking bats.
motives: Blot out the moon, murmur, spread disease

features.name: Orda (2d6)
features.text: When the Swarm has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6 physical damage instead.

features.name: Moltitudine Accecante
features.text: The Swarm is so thick it blocks the vision of anyone it interacts with. Creatures within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks made against adversaries other than the Swarm.

features.name: Sciame Succhiasangue
features.text: When the Swarm deals damage to a target, you can mark a Stress to have the Swarm feed. The target marks an additional HP, and the Swarm clears a HP.

name: Sovrano Vampiro
desc: A cruel vampire lord from a long-lost age, cursed with immortality.
motives: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Vampire Lord can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cuore della Mezzanotte
features.text: Long-Term Countdown (6). The Vampire Lord keeps their heart hidden in a safe place. If it’s destroyed, the Vampire Lord dies. Otherwise, when the Vampire Lord is defeated, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the PCs finish a long rest. When it triggers, the Vampire Lord revives within Close range of the heart with all HP and Stress cleared.

features.name: Terrificante
features.text: When the Vampire Lord makes a successful attack roll, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Scatenare le Fiamme dell’Inferno
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Vampire Lord momentarily conjure 1d4 bursts of hellfire within Far range. Each burst deals 3d6 magic damage to each target within Very Close range. If a target takes damage from multiple bursts, combine the damage.

features.name: Rinascita
features.text: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Hope, you can spend a Fear to clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Fondersi nelle Ombre
features.text: When a PC would deal damage to the Vampire Lord, you can spend a Fear to roll a d6. On a result of 5 or higher, negate the damage, then teleport the Vampire Lord to a point within Far range. Hellwing - Evolution: When the Vampire Lord marks half their HP, they transform into the Hellwing: a towering, demonic bat creature. They gain the “On Crimson Wings” and “Bloodbath” features and replace their standard attack with the following standard attack: Claws: Close | 3d12+6 phy

features.name: Su Ali Cremisi
features.text: While flying, the Hellwing gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Bagno di Sangue
features.text: When the Hellwing takes Major or greater damage, the ground within Very Close range is covered with blood, dealing 3d10 magic damage to all other creatures in the area. When the Hellwing takes the spotlight on subsequent GM turns, all other creatures in that area take 3d6 magic damage.

name: Carceriere della Cripta
desc: A boxy, dust-covered construct with thick metallic swinging doors on their torso.
motives: Carry away, entrap, protect, pummel

features.name: Parata con Scudo
features.text: Creatures within Melee range of the Gaoler have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. Creatures trapped inside the Gaoler are immune to this feature.

features.name: Chiuso a Chiave
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target is Restrained within the Gaoler until freed with a successful Strength Roll (18). While Restrained, the target can only attack the Gaoler.

name: Sentinella della Cripta
desc: A dust-covered golden construct with boxy limbs and a huge mace for a hand.
motives: Destroy at any cost, expunge, protect

features.name: Schianto Cinetico
features.text: Targets who take damage from the Sentinel’s standard attack are knocked back to Very Close range.

features.name: Mettere alle Strette
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Very Close range to focus on. That target has disadvantage on attack rolls when they’re within Very Close range of the Sentinel. The Sentinel can only focus on one target at a time.

features.name: Dardo di Mana
features.text: Spend a Fear to lob explosive magic at a point within Far range. All targets within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d8+20 magic damage and are knocked back to Close range. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren’t knocked back.

features.name: Slancio
features.text: When the Sentinel makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Torretta della Cripta
desc: A massive living turret with reinforced armor and twelve piston- driven mechanical legs.
motives: Concentrate fire, lock down, mark, protect

features.name: Lenta Cadenza di Fuoco
features.text: When you spotlight the Turret and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t make a standard attack. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the Turret and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can attack.

features.name: Inquadrare il Bersaglio
features.text: Spend a Fear to Mark a target within Far range until the Turret is destroyed or the Marked target becomes Hidden. While the target is Marked, their Evasion is halved.

features.name: Concentrare il Fuoco
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Far range of the Turret, you can mark a Stress to add the Turret’s standard attack damage to the damage roll.

features.name: Detonazione
features.text: When the Turret is destroyed, they explode. All targets within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 3d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

name: Suggiviscere
desc: A vampiric demon whose upper body detaches at sundown to fly through nearby villages in search of victims. It has a winged upper body with hanging entrails.
motives: Clamp onto prey, suck blood, tear in half

features.name: Riunisciti o Muori
features.text: The Viscera Sucker dies if it hasn’t reconnected its upper and lower halves by dawn.

features.name: Visceri Intrappolanti
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Viscera Sucker latch onto a target within Very Close range, Restraining them until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (16).

features.name: Risucchio Vitale
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Viscera Sucker drink blood from a Restrained target within Melee range. The target marks a HP, and the Viscera Sucker clears a HP.

name: Wraith Bisbigliante
desc: The echoes of broken promises and dreams unfulfilled, manifesting as a floating, translucent shroud of tattered black velvet in a vaguely humanoid shape.
motives: Bind limbs, drop from a great height, lift off the ground, swirl through the air, wrap around heads

features.name: Ectoplasma Maggiore
features.text: The Wraith has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.

features.name: Sinistro
features.text: When the Wraith makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Sudario d’Incubo
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Wraith wrap itself around a PC within Melee range, Shrouding the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll to dislodge the Wraith or the Wraith takes Major or greater damage. While Shrouded, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and marks a Stress when they roll with Fear. Additionally, damage that would be dealt to the Wraith is split evenly between the Wraith and the Shrouded target.

name: Viverna
desc: A two-legged dragon that flies from its mountaintop aerie to devour livestock.
motives: Cast a long shadow, snatch and grab, wheel through the air

features.name: Doppio Attacco
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Wyvern make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Strillo Terrificante
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Wyvern let out a spine-chilling screech. All PCs within Far range are Terrified until they succeed on a Presence Roll (18) to clear the condition or the Wyvern is defeated. While Terrified, a PC doesn’t gain a Hope when they roll with Hope.

features.name: Stretta
features.text: When the Wyvern makes a successful attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to have the Wyvern Restrain the target in its claws until the PC succeeds on a Strength Roll (18) or the Wyvern takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained in this way, the PC has disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Giovane Drago di Fuoco
desc: A crimson dragon with four powerful limbs and smoldering wings.
motives: Burn, defend lair, erupt, fly, shred, take

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Intimidire
features.text: When you spend a Fear to spotlight the Dragon, all PCs within Close range must mark a Stress or lose a Hope.

features.name: Soffio di Fiamme
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a blast of flame against all targets in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8+3 magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage. A target who marks HP from this attack also becomes Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Eruzione
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon crack the earth open with its tail, unleashing an explosion of lava. Choose a point within Far range. Each PC on the line between the Dragon and the chosen point must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or get burned, becoming Vulnerable until their next rest. You gain a Fear for each PC who fails.

features.name: Scaglie Incandescenti
features.text: When a creature within Very Close range attacks the Dragon, the attacker must mark a Stress.

features.name: Taglia e Brucia
features.text: When the Dragon makes a successful standard attack, you gain a Fear and can mark a Stress to have the attack deal an extra 10 magic damage.

name: Drago dei Ghiacci Giovane
desc: A glacier-blue dragon with four powerful limbs and frost-tinged wings.
motives: Avalanche, defend lair, fly, freeze, defend what is mine, maul

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Squarta e Schiaccia
features.text: If a target damaged by the Dragon doesn’t mark an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Nessuna Speranza
features.text: When a PC rolls with Fear while within Far range of the Dragon, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Soffio della Tormenta
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to release an icy whorl in front of the Dragon within Close range. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d6+5 magic damage and are Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed must mark 2 Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Valanga
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon unleash a huge downfall of snow and ice, covering all other creatures within Far range. All targets within this area must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be buried in snow and rocks, becoming Vulnerable until they dig themselves out from the debris. For each PC that fails the reaction roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Scaglie Ghiacciate
features.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon from within Very Close range, they must mark a Stress and become Chilled until their next rest or they clear a Stress. While they are Chilled, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

features.name: Slancio
features.text: When the Dragon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Arci-Negromante
desc: A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes.
motives: Corrupt, decay, flee to fight another day, resurrect

features.name: Danza della Morte
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you spend a Fear.

features.name: Raggio Corruttore
features.text: Mark 2 Stress to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d20+12 magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark 2 Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Aprire i Cancelli della Morte
features.text: Spend a Fear to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Non Oggi, Miei Cari
features.text: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

features.name: La Tua Vita È Mia
features.text: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal 2d10+6 direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then clears a number of Stress or HP equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack. 10)

name: Abominio Cephilith
desc: A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin.
motives: Do the heavy lifting, leap menacingly, move surprisingly fast, smash and grab

features.name: Pelle Tossica
features.text: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

features.name: Presa dell’Orso
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is Grappled until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

features.name: Sgranocchiare!
features.text: Spend a Fear to deal 4d12 direct physical damage to a creature Grappled by the Abomination.

features.name: Lingua Appiccicosa
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

features.name: Sanguisughe Parassite
features.text: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in 2d4 leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

name: Cephilith Cucciolo
desc: A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey’s skull, bathing the victim’s brain in extradimensional neurotoxins.
motives: Climb, feed, hatch, numb, scuttle

features.name: Seguace (12)
features.text: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Indurre in Coma
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC’s brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. If a PC marks their last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a death move. If the PC dies, you can spend a Fear to resurrect them as a Cephilith Novitiate.

features.name: Attacco in Massa
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Hatchlings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Novizio dei Cephilith
desc: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.
motives: Help others see the Truth, make way for It, seek forbidden knowledge

features.name: Servitore (12)
features.text: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Attacco in Massa
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Immolarsi
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

name: Sacerdote Cephilith
desc: A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see wriggling worms.
motives: Break the unbelievers’ minds, prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan’s arrival, sing its praises

features.name: Deflagrazione Psichica
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 2d10+5 direct magic damage. Targets who fail take 4d10+10 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

features.name: Incursione Cerebrale
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a Vulnerable target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target’s ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

features.name: Stretta Telecinetica
features.text: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they spend a Hope.

name: Titano Cephilith
desc: A transdimensional entity in the form of an impossibly large, winged humanoid with an octopus-shaped head and rows of glowing eyes.
motives: Call and consume followers, corrupt reality, invade the Mortal Realm, spew forth chaos

features.name: Inesorabile (X)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Terrificante
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Solo una Proiezione
features.text: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating their true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Urlo Psichico
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. Each PC within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (22). Targets who fail take 4d12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Richiamare i Devoti
features.text: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight. “It’s Here…” - Evolution: When the Titan has marked half their HP, they manifest in their full form, clearing all HP and losing the “Merely a Projection” feature. While the Titan is in this form, a creature who marks HP from the Titan’s standard attack must mark an additional HP.

name: Cipactli
desc: A gargantuan crocodile that has a body covered in a patchwork of fish scales, toad skin, and dozens of hungry mouths.
motives: Consume, reshape the land, trample

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Molte Bocche
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Cipactli succeeds against must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Pasto Famelico
features.text: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Close range to succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 4d6 direct physical damage. The Cipactli clears a HP for each creature who took Severe damage from this attack.

features.name: Passi Sismici
features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until they take damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Sangue Fertilizzante
features.text: When the Cipactli takes Severe damage, its blood splashes to the ground and instantly erupts into a jungle. All creatures within Close range are temporarily Restrained.

features.name: Esplosione di Vegetazione
features.text: When the Cipactli marks its last HP, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

name: Titano delle Nuvole
desc: A devastatingly attractive, blue-skinned goliath dressed in the finest silks and dripping with jewelry. They luxuriate in the finer things and dwell in a sky palace filled with treasure.
motives: Acquire rare and valuable things, celebrate beauty, never pass up an interesting wager

features.name: Scagliare il Fulmine
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+14 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a different target within Very Close range of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by 1d10.

features.name: Tessere la Foschia
features.text: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within Close range of that point. The Titan is Hidden to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has advantage on attacks against creatures inside it. The fog lasts until the Titan marks HP.

features.name: Trasformarsi in Nuvola
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

features.name: Aprire la Voliera
features.text: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to summon an equal number of Griffins, which appear at Close range.

features.name: Plasmare il Vento
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Titan blast wind at a target within Close range. The target takes 4d6+8 physical damage and is pushed back to Far range from their current position.

features.name: Lascia o Raddoppia
features.text: When you would gain a Fear from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a d6. On an odd result, you don’t gain the Fear. On an even result, you gain 2 Fear instead of 1.

name: Berzug, Signore Demoniaco
desc: The ruler of a deep circle in the Circles Below and a huge hybrid beast with a serpent’s tail, a lizard’s hind legs, a crab’s claw arms, and a two-faced wolf’s head.
motives: Destroy goodness, sow chaos, unseat rivals

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Frustata di Caos
features.text: Mark a Stress to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within Close range and force each target to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Scrutare nell’Abisso
features.text: Spend a Fear to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within Far range. The target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain one of the following conditions (roll a d6 and use the corresponding result): 1–2: Mesmerized. The target immediately moves into Melee range of Berzug and is Vulnerable and Restrained until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll. 3–4: Confused. The target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll until they clear the condition with a successful Knowledge Roll. 5–6: Enthralled. Until the PC makes a successful Presence Roll to clear the condition, you can spotlight them during a GM turn as if they were an adversary. When you do so, choose a target within Close range of the Enthralled PC. The Enthralled PC moves into Melee range of the target and makes a weapon attack against them using a d20 instead of Duality Dice.

features.name: Attacco Frantumante
features.text: When a PC marks HP from Berzug’s standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force them to mark a number of Stress equal to the number of HP they marked. You gain a Fear.

features.name: Orripilante
features.text: When a PC fails an attack against Berzug, you gain a Fear.

name: Mitera, Madre dei Draghi
desc: A gargantuan seven-headed dragon with dazzling diamond scales that shine with every color of the rainbow.
motives: Birth destruction, control the battlefield, fly, repel invaders, use all available options

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: Mitera can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Pelle Adamantina
features.text: Countdown (7). When Mitera first appears, activate the countdown. Mitera gains a bonus to her Difficulty equal to the countdown die’s current value. It ticks down from Mitera’s “Seven-Headed” feature. When the countdown triggers, Mitera becomes Vulnerable and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

features.name: Soffio Elementale
features.text: Mark a Stress to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice: 1. Fire. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d4+1 targets within Close range. Targets who take damage must mark an Armor Slot or 2 additional HP. 2. Lightning. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d6 targets within Far range, so long as each target beyond the first is within Close range of the previous target. 3. Acid. Each PC in front of Mitera within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Armor Slots and 2 HP. Targets who succeed must mark an Armor Slot and a HP. 4. Poison. A miasma of toxic swamp gas Sickens all targets within Close range of Mitera. While Sickened, a target has disadvantage on action rolls until they mark 1d4 Stress to clear the condition. 5. Ice. Each target in front of Mitera within Close range takes 4d8+8 magic damage and is Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Additionally, this area freezes over and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll to move through it. 6. Darkness. A cloud of magical shadow fills an area within Close range. Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are Vulnerable and have disadvantage on action rolls that rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera’s “Seven-Headed” feature. 7. Light. A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within Very Far range.

features.name: Spazzata di Coda
features.text: Spend a Fear to attack all targets within Close range. Targets this attack succeeds against take 2d20+10 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range. Targets who mark HP from this attack become Vulnerable until they clear a HP. Targets this attack failed against must mark a Stress.

features.name: Temibile
features.text: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within Far range, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Sette Teste
features.text: When Mitera takes damage, roll a d8. Permanently remove the “Elemental Breath” option that corresponds to the result. On a result of 8, or if the corresponding option has already been removed, tick down the Diamond Hide countdown (see “Diamond Hide”).

name: Truppa d’Assalto dei Caduti
desc: A cursed soul bound to the Fallen’s will.
motives: Crush, dominate, earn relief, punish

features.name: Seguace (12)
features.text: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Aura del Destino
features.text: When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Attacco in Massa
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Stregone dei Caduti
desc: A powerful mage bound by the bargains they made in life.
motives: Acquire, dishearten, dominate, torment

features.name: Conflagrazione
features.text: Spend a Fear to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take 2d10+6 direct magic damage.

features.name: Visione d’Incubo
features.text: Mark a Stress to trap a target within Far range in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Sfuggente
features.text: When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to Far range.

features.name: Catene del Rimpianto
features.text: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become Vulnerable and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope. FALLEN WARLORD:

name: Signore della Guerra dei Caduti: Distruttore di Reami
desc: A Fallen God, wreathed in rage and resentment, bearing millennia of experience in breaking heroes’ spirits.
motives: Corrupt, dominate, punish, break the weak

features.name: Inesorabile (2)
features.text: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Armatura a Piastre Sputafuoco
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by 2d10.

features.name: Frusta del Tormento
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

features.name: La Furia che Tutto Consuma
features.text: Countdown (Decreasing 8). When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d6+10 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.

features.name: Esecutore del Fato
features.text: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

features.name: Non Ho Mai Conosciuto Sconfitta (Cambio di Fase)
features.name_en: I Have Never Known Defeat (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them. FALLEN WARLORD:

name: Signore della Guerra dei Caduti: Campione Imbattuto
desc: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.
motives: Dispatch merciless death, punish the defiant, secure victory at any cost

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Armatura Frantumata
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by 1d10.

features.name: Colpo Frantumante
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

features.name: Legioni Infinite
features.text: Spend a Fear to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

features.name: Cerchio di Profanazione
features.text: Countdown (1d8). When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

features.name: Slancio
features.text: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Portatore di Sventura
features.text: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

name: Condottiero dei Titani del Fuoco
desc: A smoldering, battle-obsessed goliath wearing bespoke armor and wielding a massive maul.
motives: Compete against rivals, conquer the weak, craft colossal war machines

features.name: Inesorabile (2)
features.text: The Warlord can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Creatore di Colossi
features.text: Countdown (6). When the Warlord enters the scene, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Warlord is spotlighted. When it triggers, summon the Gargantuan War Machine, which appears at the edge of the battlefield and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Sguinzagliare i Segugi
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord summon two Demonic Hound Packs, which appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Attacco Turbinante
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range and gain a Fear.

features.name: Spaccare la Terra
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord crack the earth with a downward swing of their maul and make an attack against a group within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d10+10 direct damage. The area becomes rough terrain, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

name: Congegno Bellico Colossale
desc: A 100-foot-tall adamantine construct that has gemstone eyes, powered by a chest crucible of elemental flame.
motives: Crush, destroy

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Machine can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Dimensioni Titaniche
features.text: When the Machine enters the battlefield, each PC must either lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Pugno Razzo
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d12+10 direct physical damage and marks 2 Armor Slots without gaining their benefits.

features.name: Pestata Sismica
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a point within Close range and make an attack roll against all enemies within Close range of that point. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d12 direct physical damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Additionally, the entire area becomes rubble, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

features.name: Sovralimentato
features.text: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Machine is spotlighted for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the Machine is spotlighted. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block as the Machine’s chest crucible flares with magical flame. For each token on this stat block, the Machine gains a +1 bonus to Difficulty and attack rolls, and its standard attack deals an extra 1d12 damage. Remove a token when the Machine takes Severe damage.

name: Legione Fantasma
desc: A teeming army of ghosts roused from dreamless slumber to fulfill their ancient oath.
motives: Overwhelm, serve, swarm

features.name: Orda (2d6+5)
features.text: When the Legion has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6+5 magic damage instead.

features.name: Necroplasma
features.text: The Legion is immune to physical damage and takes double magic damage.

features.name: Atto Finale
features.text: When the Legion is defeated, it makes a standard attack against all targets within Close range before being dispelled.

name: Grifone
desc: A large leonine creature that has the head, talons, and wings of an eagle.
motives: Hunt, look for an opening, swoop

features.name: Accumulatore di Tesori
features.text: When a PC would mark any number of HP from the Griffin’s attack, the PC can choose instead to give the Griffin an equal number of bags of gold.

features.name: Picchiata Fenditrice
features.text: Move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target along the way.

name: Arciere Santificato
desc: Spirit soldiers with sanctified bows.
motives: Focus fire, obey, reposition, volley

features.name: Punire i Colpevoli
features.text: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked Guilty by a High Seraph.

features.name: Salva Divina
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

name: Coro Santificato
desc: A heavenly host of winged humanoids whose song calls forth tears of religious awe.
motives: Drown out disbelief, raise voices

features.name: Orda (2d10)
features.text: When the Choir has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d10 magic damage instead.

features.name: Coda Celestiale
features.text: Countdown (Loop 3). The Choir’s divine song builds on itself with each refrain. When the Choir first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC gains a Hope. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block. The Choir gains a bonus to its damage rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block.

features.name: Assalto Sonoro
features.text: The Choir unleashes its built-up divine energy in a single burst, clearing all tokens from this stat block. Deal 1d12 direct magic damage to each enemy within Close range for each token cleared.

name: Soldato Santificato
desc: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.
motives: Obey, outmaneuver, punish, swarm

features.name: Seguace (13)
features.text: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Volo Divino
features.text: While the Soldier is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Attacco in Massa
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Araldo della Morte
desc: A desiccated corpse riding atop a skeletal horse. Their eyes are sewn shut and their body is wrapped in a burial shroud of dust and ash.
motives: Bring judgment, cut them down, move swiftly, seek relentlessly, take souls

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cavalcatura
features.text: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Temete il Mietitore
features.text: When a creature is defeated within Far range of the Harbinger, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Decapitare
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger make an attack roll against a PC within Melee range. On a success, roll a d6. On a result of 6, the target marks all HP and must make a death move.

features.name: Risvegliare i Caduti
features.text: Spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to have the Harbinger resurrect a defeated ally within Far range. The resurrected ally clears a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked. Immediately spotlight the ally.

features.name: Cenere alla Cenere, Polvere alla Polvere
features.name_en: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
features.text: When the Harbinger would mark HP, you can mark a Stress to have an ally within Far range mark the HP instead.

name: Araldo della Carestia
desc: A dried-out husk of a body riding atop a withered white horse. They are covered in mouths and surrounded by swarming flies.
motives: Drain, impoverish, weaken, wither

features.name: Inesorabile (2)
features.text: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cavalcatura
features.text: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Fitte della Fame
features.text: Countdown (Decreasing 6). When the Harbinger appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Harbinger is spotlighted. When it triggers, all PCs within Far range mark a Stress and become Ravenous. While Ravenous, a PC can’t spend Hope until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Prosciugare Essenza
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs. Each target takes 4d6 magic damage.

features.name: Troppe Bocche
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a PC within Melee range. On a success, the Harbinger grabs the target and bites them, dealing 4d6 physical damage and Restraining the target until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Tocco Avvizzente
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger caress the face of a Restrained PC within Melee range. The target marks 2 Stress and either loses a Hope or marks 1d4 HP.

name: Araldo della Pestilenza
desc: A bloated and rotting agglomeration of wriggling insects and slugs formed into a single humanoid mass riding a worm-eaten horse.
motives: Corrupt the pure, infect the weak, summon plague and disease

features.name: Alone del Contagio
features.text: The Harbinger is Contagious. When a PC within Very Close range of a Contagious creature takes an action, the PC rolls a d6. On a result of 1, the PC becomes Contagious. While Contagious, a PC has disadvantage on action rolls until they spend 3 Hope to clear the condition. Contagious adversaries are unaffected by the condition.

features.name: Cavalcatura
features.text: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Sciame di Locuste
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a swarm of locusts at a point within Very Far range. Each PC within Close range of that point must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d10 direct physical damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1–2, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Progenie di Rane
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a clutch of diseased frogs inside the mouths of up to three PCs within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 4d12 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1–3, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Portatore della Piaga
features.text: Mark any number of Stress up to the number of PCs in the scene. For each Stress you mark, the Harbinger summons 1d4 Contagious Zombie Legions within Far range and immediately spotlights one of them.

name: Araldo della Guerra
desc: A warrior clad in black armor and a horned helmet and bearing a bloody banner.
motives: Destroy utterly, fight honorably, relish combat, shield-bash, strike powerfully

features.name: Inesorabile (2)
features.text: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cavalcatura
features.text: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Dadi di Ferro
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Harbinger attempt a risky all-out attack. Make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, the target marks an additional HP. On a failure, the Harbinger becomes Vulnerable until they take or deal damage.

features.name: Comandante Supremo
features.text: Once per scene, spend a Fear to summon 1d6 Hallowed Soldiers within Close range and immediately spotlight one of them.

features.name: Ariete d’Assedio
features.text: When a PC fails an action roll within Close range, you can spend a Fear to move into Melee range with the PC and make a standard attack with advantage against them. On a success, the PC takes standard damage and is Vulnerable until they are spotlighted.

name: Campione Consacrato
desc: A divine champion, head of a hallowed host of warriors who enforce their god’s will.
motives: Enforce dogma, fly, pronounce judgment, smite

features.name: Inesorabile (2)
features.text: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Volo Divino
features.text: While the Seraph is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Giudizio
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a target Guilty in the eyes of the Seraph’s god until the Seraph is defeated. While Guilty, the target doesn’t gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a Guilty target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

features.name: Strali Divini
features.text: Mark a Stress to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked Guilty. Targets who fail take 4d6+12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Noi Siamo Uno
features.text: Once per scene, spend a Fear to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

name: Kraken
desc: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.
motives: Consume, crush, drown, grapple

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Molti Tentacoli
features.text: While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

features.name: Afferra e Affoga
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained and Vulnerable in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

features.name: Esplosione Ribollente
features.text: Spend a Fear to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+9 physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Slancio
features.text: When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Oracolo del Fato
desc: A towering immortal and incarnation of fate, cursed to only see bad outcomes.
motives: Change environment, condemn, dishearten, toss aside

features.name: Terrificante
features.text: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Il Cerchio si Stringe
features.text: When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Profetizzare
features.text: Spend a Fear to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take 2d20+4 direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.

features.name: Evoca Tormentatori
features.text: Once per day, spend 2 Fear to summon 2d4 Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC’s personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

features.name: Conoscenza Inquietante
features.text: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

features.name: Destino Vendicativo
features.text: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

name: Abominio dei Regni Esterni
desc: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.
motives: Demolish, devour, undermine

features.name: Forma del Caos
features.text: When the Abomination attacks, roll 2d4 and use the result as their attack modifier.

features.name: Presenza Disorientante
features.text: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Sconvolgere la Realtà
features.text: Spend a Fear to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become Unstuck from reality until the end of the scene. When an Unstuck target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

features.name: Forma Irreale
features.text: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by 1d20. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

name: Corruttore dei Reami Esterni
desc: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.
motives: Confuse, distract, overwhelm

features.name: Tocco che Abbatte la Volontà
features.text: When a PC takes damage from the Corrupter, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Vomitare Avanzi di Realtà
features.text: Mark a Stress to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

name: Servitore dei Reami Esterni
desc: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.
motives: Destroy, disgust, disorient, intimidate

features.name: Seguace (13)
features.text: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Attacco in Massa
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Gufo Stregato
desc: A giant, vengeful barn owl that has a 15-foot wingspan and a human face.
motives: Consume essence, curse, predict death

features.name: Cattivo Presagio
features.text: When a PC within Close range makes an action roll, their Fear Die gains a bonus equal to the amount of Fear you have.

features.name: Barriera Stregata
features.text: The Owl Witch has resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Imitare le Voci
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch beckon with the voice of a beloved figure to a creature within earshot. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or move up to Far range toward the Owl Witch.

features.name: Occhiata da Incubo
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch Afflict a PC within Far range with waking nightmares unless the target succeeds on a Knowledge Reaction Roll. While Afflicted, the target can’t clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort the Afflicted creature.

features.name: Visioni di una Fine Violenta
features.text: When the Owl Witch is targeted by an attack, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark 1d4 Stress as their mind is flooded with harrowing imagery.

name: Drago di Rubino
desc: A huge winged dragon that has visible flames beneath its glittering, gem-encrusted scales. Its body heat melts stone.
motives: Crack the earth, melt, protect treasure

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Temibile
features.text: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Soffio di Fusione
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d12+10 magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Fenditura Vulcanica
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take 4d8+5 magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes 4d8+5 magic damage.

features.name: Sangue Caldo
features.text: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon’s blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they mark 1d4 HP.

name: Ombra Recisa
desc: A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces.
motives: Curse the light, slip between the cracks, split and reform

features.name: Seguace (12)
features.text: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Ombra Afferrante
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

features.name: Attacco in Massa
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Severed Shadows within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Adonix, Demiurgo Supremo
desc: The four-faced angel from the Hallows Above who manifests in the Mortal Realm as a floating tetrahedron with numerous eyes and multiple sets of metallic feathered wings.
motives: Establish dominion, exile from reality, float above it all, speak into being

features.name: Inesorabile (4)
features.text: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Arconte Elementale
features.text: Mark a Stress to roll a d4. Adonix activates the corresponding effect: 1. Fire Beam. Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield. Each target in the beam’s path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take Severe damage. Targets who succeed take Minor damage. 2. Thunderclap. All creatures within Far range must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated. 3. Lightning Bolt. Make an attack against a target within Very Far range, dealing 4d8 magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a different target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run out of targets. 4. Ice Storm. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d4 Stress and become Restrained until they spend a Hope to escape. Alpha to Omega - Evolution: When Adonix is defeated, they resurrect in Omega form with all HP and Stress cleared. Each PC within Very Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or lose a Hope. You gain a Fear for each Hope lost in this way. Adonix gains the following features in this form:

features.name: Rinnegare
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a PC and activate a Forsaken Countdown (1d8) for them. It ticks down when Adonix is spotlighted. When it triggers, the PC must mark all their HP. The countdown ends if Adonix takes Severe damage. You can have only one Forsaken Countdown active at a time.

features.name: Armageddon
features.text: When Adonix is defeated again, they unleash a reality storm that shakes the realms to their foundations. Roll a d6. On a result of 5–6, each PC must make a death move.

name: Custode Temporale
