desc: A giant mechanical being from a dimension outside time, built by the Time Keepers to preserve the Holy Continuum.
motives: Repair the timeline, seek out temporal heretics, serve the Lords of Continuity

features.name: Inesorabile (2)
features.text: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Ciclo Temporale
features.text: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Enforcer first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all HP, Stress, and conditions. Reroll the countdown when the Enforcer takes Severe damage.

features.name: Muoversi tra gli Attimi
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within Very Far range, then spotlight them again.

features.name: Riavvolgimento Istantaneo
features.text: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the die.

features.name: Inversione di Polarità
features.text: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This effect can’t be used to alter a critical success. VOLCANIC DRAGON:

name: Predatore d’Ossidiana
desc: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.
motives: Defend lair, dive-bomb, fly, hunt, intimidate

features.name: Inesorabile (2)
features.text: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Volare
features.text: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Scaglie di Ossidiana
features.text: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Coda Travolgente
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 4d6+4 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range and Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.

features.name: Bombardamento in Picchiata
features.text: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 2d10+6 physical damage and must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

features.name: Furia Eruttiva (Cambio di Fase)
features.text: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them. VOLCANIC DRAGON:

name: Flagello Fuso
desc: Enraged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava.
motives: Douse with lava, incinerate, repel Invaders, reposition

features.name: Inesorabile (3)
features.text: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Scaglie Incrinate
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of d6s equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Potenza Frantumante
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d8+1 physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

features.name: Eruzione
features.text: Spend a Fear to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge’s scales, filling the area within Very Close range with molten lava. All targets in that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+6 physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. This area remains lava. When a creature other than the Molten Scourge enters that area or acts while inside of it, they must mark 6 HP.

features.name: Soffio Vulcanico
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll a d10. On a result of 8 or higher, the Molten Scourge breathes a flow of lava in front of them within Far range. All targets in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+4 physical damage, mark 1d4 Stress, and are Vulnerable until they clear a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Spruzzo di Lava
features.text: When the Molten Scourge takes Severe damage from an attack within Very Close range, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals 2d10+4 direct physical damage to the attacker.

features.name: Ceneri della Vendetta (Cambio di Fase)
features.text: When the Molten Scourge marks their last HP, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately spotlight them. VOLCANIC DRAGON:

name: Tiranno della Cenere
desc: No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so. As the lava settles, it’s ground to ash like the dragon’s past foes.
motives: Choke, fly, intimidate, kill or be killed

features.name: Inesorabile (4)
features.text: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: All’Angolo
features.text: Mark a Stress instead of spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.

features.name: Ali Straziate
features.text: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Cenere alla Cenere
features.text: When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can’t lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

features.name: Furia Disperata
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take 2d20+2 physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Nube di Cenere
features.text: Spend a Fear to smash the ground and kick up ash within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

features.name: Disfatta Apocalittica
features.text: Countdown (1d12). Spend a Fear to activate. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+10 physical damage and are Restrained by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

name: Madre delle Acque
desc: A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water.
motives: Constrict the world, control the battlefield, draw enemies into the water

features.name: Segmenti
features.text: The Water Mother’s body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The Water Mother always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the Water Mother with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the Water Mother can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the Water Mother and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.

features.name: Divorare il Mondo
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Water Mother inhale sharply. Each PC within Close range of her Head must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and be pulled within Melee range of the Head. The Water Mother then makes a standard attack against all targets within Melee range of her Head.

features.name: Stritolare
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d8+8 physical damage and are temporarily Restrained. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can mark a Stress to force all targets Restrained by the Water Mother to mark a HP.

features.name: Ondata Venefica
features.text: When the Water Mother makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable until the end of the scene.

name: Mostruosità Draconica
desc: A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic. Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master’s will than as individual beings.
motives: Hold the line, sacrifice, serve, swarm

features.name: Seguace (13)
features.text: The Wyrmfiend is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Wyrmfiend, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Morso Velenoso
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d4+4 physical damage and Poison the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Attacco in Massa
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Wyrmfiends within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

name: Nidiata Draconica
desc: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they’re furious, hungry, and stupid.
motives: Consume, shred, swarm

features.name: Orda (2d6+5)
features.text: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Famelica
features.text: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can spend a Fear to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

features.name: Sopraffare
features.text: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

name: Xero, l’Assassino di Fortezze
desc: A castle-sized, bipedal reptile.
motives: Leave a wake of destruction, level buildings, stomp through settlements

features.name: Inesorabile (X)
features.text: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Danno Collaterale
features.text: Xero’s movement can’t be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero’s path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

features.name: Calpestamento Tellurico
features.text: Spend a Fear to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes 4d12 physical damage and is Restrained until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d12 physical damage as they land.

features.name: Scivolata Poderosa
features.text: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

features.name: Respiro Radioattivo
features.text: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can spend this token and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d12+12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can’t use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

features.name: Rigenerazione
features.text: Up to three times per scene, spend any number of Fear to clear an equal number of HP.

name: Zombi Perfezionato
desc: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.
motives: Consume, hound, maim, terrify

features.name: Terrificante
features.text: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Presenza Spaventosa
features.text: PCs can’t spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

features.name: Colpo Perfetto
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are Vulnerable until their next rest.

features.name: Abile Opportunista
features.text: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Very Close range of the Zombie, you can spend a Fear to add the Zombie’s standard attack damage to the damage roll.
